description: Enrolls a Spotify playlist in automated cloud monitoring for daily follower snapshots, growth trend analysis, and inorganic spike alerts. Allows up to 25 monitored playlists per Premium account. Adding a playlist that is already monitored leaves its existing name and track_id unchanged; to change them, call remove_monitor first.

name.description: Optional custom display label for the monitor.

playlist.description: Spotify playlist URL, URI, or 22-character playlist ID to monitor.

track_id.description: Optional 22-character Spotify track ID to track placement status alerts for.

name: add_monitor
